thread:
maria_sales: Hey team — new enterprise POC (FinTech customer) starting next week. Need a consolidated onboarding checklist for provisioning: hosted API keys, Dedicated pool fallback, and Private/VPC options. Also expect security questionnaire. Can we align owners + quick runbook?

alex_dev: I can own hosted API key flow + sample configs. Quick notes: create scoped API key, set rate limits, attach usage plan. CLI snippet: 
```
redwoodctl api-keys create --name poc-fintech --scopes generate,embed --quota 100k
``` 
Will also add sample server-side token rotation snippet.

sam_infra: I’ll take Dedicated and VPC network. Need customer vNET CIDR & contact for peering (ask them for BGP or static?). For Dedicated fallback, we should pre-allocate a small pool (2x A100) and set autoscale policy to burst-only. I'll post recommended config.

jess_pm: Adding SSO + SCIM? Customer asks for SAML dev accounts in the POC. @rachel_support can you prep the SAML template and brief on onboarding timeline? 

rachel_support: Yep. I’ll create SAML template and a one-pager for admin steps. ETA EOD today. Also we should prep a short FAQ for pricing expectations (trial vs committed Dedicated).

maria_sales: Great. For security questionnaire, customer will ask about KMS integration, data residency, audit logs. Who owns answers? 

alex_dev: I’ll do KMS + data flow (what’s stored vs ephemeral). TL;DR: request-level payloads not persisted by default; logs/audit retained per retention policy. Will add HTTPS/TLS and cert rotation notes.

sam_infra: For VPC: need to confirm whether they want Private control plane or VPC peering. Peering steps: 1) collect CIDR, 2) create peering request, 3) open ports 443 and 10250, 4) validate routes. I'll draft playbook.

maria_sales: Can we get an internal runbook link so AE can shotgun-share with customer? 

deploy-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-access-gatekeeper (auto-generated). 

jess_pm: I'll consolidate into a 1-page onboarding checklist with owners and ETA. Plan: hosted API key + sample server integration (Day 0), Dedicated pool reservation + smoke test (Day 1-2), VPC peering (Day 2-4), security questionnaire (Day 1), SAML + admin invite (Day 0-1). 

alex_dev: Also include quick troubleshooting steps: token 401 > rotate key, high latency > switch routing to dedicated, 5xx spikes > fallback to smaller model. 

rachel_support: Pricing FAQ: hosted per-token estimate, Dedicated trial monthly rate, commitment thresholds. I'll draft numbers and place in shared doc.

maria_sales: Perfect. @sam_infra @alex_dev can you drop your config snippets into the runbook by COB? I'll triage with AE and send to customer Friday. :thumbsup:

sam_infra: Will do. 

alex_dev: Adding now. 

rachel_support: I uploaded SAML template and pricing FAQ to the runbook. 

jess_pm: I pulled everything together and updated the checklist here: https://redwood.internal/docs/poc-onboard-checklist/1768456789 — feel free to comment.

maria_sales: Closing loop — thanks everyone. I'll ping again if customer asks for dedicated SLA numbers. :rocket:
